=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .claude/docs/s25-pr-watching-disabled.md:55 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The §25.C text moved here from CLAUDE.md still contains the retired token `send_later`. tests/test_no_session_automation.py line 25 bans it, and the test scans `.claude/` and `workflow-templates/`.
  WHY: `test_no_session_automation_remains` fails on both copies, which fails `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` and `lint`. Both copies must change identically to keep the byte-equality assertions in tests/test_pr_watch_guard.py and the live/template parity test. The reviewer suggested replacing "(`send_later`, Routines)" with "(the session scheduler, Routines)", plus a matching edit at the CLAUDE.md §25.C summary.
- TASK_GAP: s23 reference drift | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  Requirement: "That go counts as the §23.C approval for opening issues or dispatching." The agents fragment says "When a rule in one of those sections changes, edit both the `CLAUDE.md` summary and the reference file."
  Expected change site: .claude/docs/s23-github-access.md and workflow-templates/.claude/docs/s23-github-access.md, §23.C "Command-invoked dispatches are already approved" paragraph
  Evidence of absence: CLAUDE.md §23.C (about lines 985-990) ends with the §31 plan-approval sentence. Both s23 reference copies hold the pre-PR text, which ends "...initiating on your own judgement."
- TASK_GAP: "word for word" / "copied verbatim" claim | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  Requirement: the PR description says the moved text is "word for word" and the changelog says it is "copied verbatim, so no rule was dropped".
  Expected change site: changelog.d/8250-claude-md-plan-handoff.md line 4, and the PR description
  Evidence of absence: The claim stops being true once the two fixes above land. It is accurate on HEAD today, so this is conditional.
- TASK_GAP: changelog size row | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  Requirement: the changelog's size row should agree with the PR description.
  Expected change site: changelog.d/8250-claude-md-plan-handoff.md line 8
  Evidence of absence: The row reads "97,531 → about 65,900 bytes", while the PR description says "about 65,500 bytes".
- external check copilot-pull-request-reviewer | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The `copilot-pull-request-reviewer` check fails with `custom_instructions_too_large` for AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md.
  WHY: This is the external service's size cap. CLAUDE.md got smaller in this PR, so the PR did not cause it.
- HARDENING: tests/test_pr_watch_guard.py (test_claude_md_documents_the_rule) | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE=1
  PROBLEM: The PR's own test run did not include tests/test_no_session_automation.py, so a retired token in the moved text went uncaught.
  WHY: The suggested fix is to run that test before pushing, with no code change (0 lines).
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  WHY: A reader comparing the changelog with the PR description sees two byte figures for the same CLAUDE.md. scripts/assemble_changelog.py folds the fragment verbatim into CHANGELOG.md.
- TASK_GAP: s23 reference drift | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5

The PR adds a §31-plan-approval sentence to the §23.C "Command-invoked dispatches are already approved" paragraph in CLAUDE.md (lines 988-990); both s23 reference copies were not updated.
  Expected change site: .claude/docs/s23-github-access.md and workflow-templates/.claude/docs/s23-github-access.md, §23.C paragraph (after the existing "re-ask; the ask-first rule above covers dispatches you would be initiating on your own judgement." sentence)

CI on head c797b81 fails tests/test_no_session_automation.py:72, which fails tests-hooks-and-orchestrator and lint. tests/test_pr_watch_guard.py and tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py require the two s25 copies to stay byte-identical. The "word for word" and "copied verbatim" claims become false once this is reworded.

  Requirement: The changelog fragment must accurately describe what the PR shipped.
  Expected change site: changelog.d/8250-claude-md-plan-handoff.md, line 4 ("copied verbatim")
  Evidence of absence: Line 4 still says "the moved text is copied verbatim, so no rule was dropped", and the PR description still says "word for word". Both become false once the s25 reword and s23 §31 sentence land. The wording should soften to something like "moved with minimal edits".
